categories.main_business_segments: Shinih Enterprise Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the nonwoven fabric industry, producing various nonwoven products such as resin cotton, needle-punched cotton, spunbond, meltblown, and multifunctional insulation materials. The company also engages in manufacturing bedding products, automotive interior materials, filtration materials, and fire-retardant materials. Additionally, it has business activities in textile manufacturing, adhesive tape production, plastic film and bag manufacturing, machinery equipment manufacturing, rope and net production, wholesale and retail of furniture and building materials, international trade, and real estate development and leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced nonwoven fabric production technologies including spunbond, meltblown, needle-punched, water-jet, and thermal bonding processes. It integrates polyester fiber with resin and employs comprehensive manufacturing techniques to develop differentiated, multifunctional, and sustainable high-value products. The firm emphasizes process innovation, product multifunctionality, and sustainable environmental practices such as green circular manufacturing and water recycling systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shinih serves a diverse customer base across multiple industries including apparel, bedding, automotive, filtration, agriculture, medical hygiene, and construction. Its products are used in consumer goods like sanitary materials, diapers, surgical gowns, air conditioning filters, agricultural frost protection fabrics, and household insulation. The company’s customers are global, with significant sales in China, the United States, Taiwan, and other international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and sales facilities in Taiwan, China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Cambodia, the United States, and the Philippines. It has a strong presence in Asian markets, particularly in Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia, while also serving customers in North America and Europe. The firm leverages its multinational footprint to optimize supply chain integration and market responsiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shinih operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and processing nonwoven fabrics and related products. It integrates upstream raw material sourcing, mainly polyester fibers, with downstream product development and customer-oriented applications. The company also engages in supply chain coordination and service to enhance efficiency and competitiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing full-process technology integration, developing customized high-value products with multifunctional and sustainable features, and expanding global supply chain collaboration. R&D efforts emphasize innovation in spunbond and meltblown technologies, filtration materials, and environmentally friendly products. Shinih invests in smart manufacturing, automation, and digitalization to improve quality and reduce costs while fostering sustainable development through green manufacturing and circular economy initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Shinih generates revenue primarily through the sale of its nonwoven fabric products and related industrial and consumer materials. Revenue streams include product sales to diverse industries such as apparel, bedding, automotive, filtration, and agriculture. The company also earns income from international trade activities and real estate leasing, with no significant reliance on licensing or subscription models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the global nonwoven fabric industry, which is characterized by technological innovation, supply chain integration, and product differentiation. While specific competitors are not named, Shinih positions itself as a leading Taiwanese nonwoven fabric manufacturer with a comprehensive global footprint and advanced production capabilities. It leverages its technological expertise, diversified product portfolio, and multinational operations to maintain competitive advantages against regional and international players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, Shinih reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.31 billion, reflecting a 9.37% increase from the previous year. However, net profit declined by 83.75% to NT$28.68 million due to increased raw material and operational costs and the absence of prior-year non-operating gains. The company maintains total assets of over NT$6.3 billion and equity exceeding NT$3.6 billion, with ongoing investments in production capacity expansion and R&D. It demonstrates a stable growth trajectory with strategic focus on long-term sustainable development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shinih emphasizes delivering high-value, multifunctional, and sustainable nonwoven fabric products tailored to diverse customer needs. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced full-process technology integration, product innovation in spunbond and meltblown fabrics, and commitment to environmental sustainability through green manufacturing and circular economy practices. The company’s global operational footprint and strong R&D capabilities enable it to provide customized solutions with superior quality, cost efficiency, and responsiveness, fostering long-term customer trust and industry leadership.
